why_two_lanes: Reporting only the CI lane would report a pass on tests that never ran, because that lane skips every PostgreSQL-only suite by design. Reporting only the PostgreSQL lane would not be comparable to the Phase 5/6 baselines. The difference between the two IS the infrastructure-gated surface.

infrastructure_gated_surface.note: The reduction is the number of tests the CI lane could not measure and the PostgreSQL lane did. A test that still skips in the PostgreSQL lane needs something else - Redis, a running HTTP server, a built frontend bundle - and those are named in the top skip reasons.
